You also finalized the job description template for Talent Acquisition and initiated the AI requirements tool transition to Brian.

Finalize the transition of the Auto domain to Steve Ferato—relieving Thomas's workload to allow focus on core responsibilities.

Build the formal P&C architecture succession and mentorship spreadsheet—targeting completion before next quarter to stabilize the talent pipeline.

c7sm1odd5q22thn30i1mg516uo.summary: Your last sync with Larry Abel on June 26 revealed catastrophic failures in the Property Loss Model—prompting a complete rebuild mandate led by Ben Potter and Hima—which delays the Wisconsin V2 rollout and demands a three-to-six-month delivery timeline. Meanwhile, your July 17 pricing discussion with Suhas exposed severe modeling disruptions during the Ratabase-to-GuideWire migration—specifically breaking the feedback loop for model adjustments—alongside a dangerous reliance on 20,000 manual Python scripts and Excel applications. Resolving these overlapping architectural breakdowns requires establishing strict data quality controls under Dan Caldwell and Hima while transitioning mathematical modeling to a dedicated enterprise technology team.
tasks: Confirm the requirements gathering timeline for the Property Loss Model rebuild with Ben Potter and Hima—ensuring the team separates source data issues from downstream transformation logic.
Establish ownership boundaries between actuaries and the proposed Pricing Technology Team—systematically retiring the 20,000 legacy Python scripts and Excel applications.
Review the "Dammit" scope boundaries with Dan Caldwell to guarantee immediate data quality controls align with the broader GuideWire M1 migration timeline.
Address the dual-environment support gap for rating models—restoring the critical model adjustment capabilities for the actuarial teams.
c7sm1odd5q22thn30i1mg516uo.title: EA Architecture Sync

u8penhfulhdk7i5160mmnv63mo.summary: You must reconcile the core themes from your last syncs—namely Ryan Rist's update on leadership turnover and the pivot to native OEM telematics, alongside Sai's escalations regarding AI adoption bottlenecks. Frame your architectural recommendations around these friction points to align with Deepak Srinivasan on the transition to a Best of Suite model.
tasks: Finalize the competitive analysis snippet for the Suhas management meeting to address Sai's delivery concerns.
Formulate an architecture plan to transition from CMT mobile telematics to direct OEM vehicle data.
Establish a pilot program for a headless, AI-enabled quoting capability using a highly autonomous tiger team.
Audit the diagnostic tools currently managing the system's operational stability following the recent leadership changes.

6grb2j90fcasldnq2spdpsle5s.summary: Review your July 13 alignment session with Sierra—founded by Brett Taylor and Clay Bavor—to prepare for today's follow-up use case sync. You discussed Sierra's unified conversational AI platform capabilities—specifically contrasting public member-facing deployment with their internal "Live Assist" CRM desktop layer. The team confirmed a hybrid AI strategy—targeting the automation of repetitive, low-complexity tasks like incomplete First Notice of Loss filings to free up human specialists for complex interactions.
tasks: Align Sierra's conversational platform with USAA's backend systems of record—specifically focusing on real-time API and MCP server integrations.
Define the boundaries between member-facing conversational agents and the internal "Live Assist" desktop CRM tool.
Establish clear criteria for proactive outreach use cases—such as automated follow-ups for incomplete First Notice of Loss filings.
Confirm the technical architecture requirements for maintaining seamless context and memory across voice, chat, and mobile channels.
6grb2j90fcasldnq2spdpsle5s.title: Sierra & USAA | Follow-Up / Demo Use Case Sync

71kb8itqau4oe1kbcsmba65pq4.summary: Align with Arvy—the new technology leader driving platform convergence—and prepare for the upcoming September-to-November board strategy deliverables. Establish a unified architecture operating model—clarifying the distinction between Tech Fellows and Distinguished Architects—while addressing persistent legacy mainframe constraints within the PNC portfolio. Enforce the critical SDLC checkpoints—specifically the automated NFR mapping and the Jira-integrated "Permit to Design/Build/Operate" gateways—to stop downstream tool sprawl and secure early architectural engagement.
tasks: Review the technology strategy co-authoring timeline—stretching from September through November—to prepare for the upcoming alignment session with Dan.
Enforce the mandatory architecture decision records (ADRs) before vendor procurement—preventing duplicate software onboarding and uncoordinated contract finalization.
Implement the SDLC gateway overlays in Jira—establishing strict "Permit to Design / Build / Operate" checkpoints across the engineering lifecycle.
Automate the non-functional requirement (NFR) mapping to IT General Controls—eliminating manual evidence collection for the audit team.
Phase out legacy organizational terminology—specifically CTXO and EA—to align communication under the new Architecture and Tech Strategy (ATS) identity.
